jobs.description:
HOW TO REACH US

- Bekim Krasniqi (Talent Acquisition), bekim.krasniqi@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-56136 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an appointment online. Technical questions cannot be answered at this meeting.

WELCOME
If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in.
Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding.
Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us.
At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.
We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Due to the strategic realignment of the Coatings business unit, a dedicated accounting department is being established. This presents an exciting opportunity to develop and shape the finance organization from its foundation. Therefore, we are looking for a Global Functional Process Owner Book-to-Report / Record-to-Report (B2R) | Asset and Project Accounting with the following objectives:

- You own the global B2R | Asset- and Project Accounting Finance processes, which include the project accounting lifecycle from the initial financial evaluation until the execution of the financial project start-up and project closure, as well as asset accounting processes and lease accounting according to IFRS 16.
- You establish and maintain global standards for B2R | Asset- and Project Accounting processes, ensuring these are aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements across the coatings division.
- Moreover, you oversee the asset and project accounting activities, identify and drive process improvement opportunities, leveraging technology and digital solutions to enhance automation, efficiency, and continuous improvement within the finance organization.
- Furthermore, you manage a third-party business process provider in the area of Asset- and Project Accounting and implement process performance KPIs to steer the service provider.
- You collaborate closely with related functions such as project engineering, Purchase-to-Pay and General Ledger Accounting, you coordinate integration efforts and ensure holistic alignment of accounting processes.
- In addition, you engage with internal stakeholders to ensure that Asset- and Project Accounting processes meet business needs and support strategic objectives.

WHAT YOU OFFER

- university degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related field; additional certifications such as CMA or CPA are an advantage
- at least 10 years of work experience in financial process management and optimization, with a strong focus on Asset- and Project Accounting activities in a multinational corporation
- experience in the chemicals industry or a related industry, particularly during transitions or carve-outs, is highly beneficial
- strong understanding of accounting processes and process optimization methodologies
- proficiency in SAP R/3 and S/4, process mapping tools, and advanced MS Office skills
- excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders in a multicultural environment
- fluency in English is required

WHAT WE OFFER

- We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and pension related benefits.
- We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development.
- Surventis stands for diversity - we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, Color Pride and CultiConnect.
- The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g. through regular employee surveys and management feedback.
- At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio "Freizeit" with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant "Auszeit" including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center "LackiKids" and a vacation program "LackiKids on Tour".

jobs.occupation: Fluid Systems Engineer for Generator Auxiliaries (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As part of our team, you will be responsible for auxiliary systems for generators in power plants and synchronous condenser applications of customer projects. Almost every day will be different – some days you will be able to focus on your planned tasks. On other days, you will be challenged with operational topics which lead to interaction with internal colleagues, suppliers or customers. Therefore, you will have to shift your priorities at a moment’s notice to support urgent, unplanned work packages, like supporting commissioning tasks or resolving site issues. Either way, you will collaborate with a global cross-organizational team with different technical and cultural backgrounds. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Being responsible for the complete order execution process of generator auxiliary systems
* Creating and configuring system P&ID in our engineering suite COMOS including all related meta data and supporting lists, ensuring that the project requirements and customer expectations are fulfilled
* Closing interaction and cooperation with our colleagues from supply management as well as our external skid suppliers to ensure specification compliance
* Ensuring “in budget” & “in schedule” order execution from project start to end of warranty period and final inspections at the skid suppliers’ workshop prior to shipment
* Interacting with internal interface partners like I&C, electrical engineering, piping & layout planning and project management, as well as with external interface partners like EPCs and customers
* Answering customer letters and support project management in customer clarifications and meetings

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in the field of process engineering, mechanical engineering, or a comparable discipline
* Some years of professional experience and good knowledge in at least one of the above-mentioned disciplines
* Experience in a process industry-related environment (e.g. power generation, oil and gas) is beneficial
* Very good knowledge of German and English, both written and spoken is required
* Enjoying developing innovative solutions in interdisciplinary and international teams, as well as understanding customer requirements and developing concepts & solutions
* Analytical attitude and detailed work approach 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Business Continuity Officer (f/m/d) (Chief Operating Officer)
jobs.description:
You have a passion for technology and want to make the world a greener place?
Then become a playmaker and join our team as Business Continuity Officer (f/m/d) at E.ON Digital Technology.
We play a key role in shaping the energy transition by leading E.ON's digital transformation across Europe. We explore new paths by developing ideas, breaking new ground, making visions reality, and bringing new technologies to life. We deliver sustainable technology solutions because…
… it’s on us to make new energy work!

The Team – your impact
You are a member of the Business Continuity Management (BCM) team, acting as second line of defense for Business Continuity across the Business Units (BU). Together with your colleagues, you ensure that continuity risks are identified, managed, and mitigated in a consistent and effective manner. Business Continuity encompasses the resilience of all business processes, including the underlying Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT), as well as assets, operations, suppliers, employees, and facilities.
Your Role – meaningful undamp; rewarding

- Act as the primary contact for Business Continuity within the Business Unit
- Coordinate the implementation of group BCM policies and standards
- Provide advice and guidance on Business Continuity topics to the Business Unit
- Conduct and coordinate Business Impact Analyses (BIA) with process owners to identify critical processes and dependencies
- Coordinate and support internal and external BCM audits, including remediation of findings
- Drive the continuous improvement of the BCM framework
- Develop and steer BCM roadmaps and maturity development
- Ensure that Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery tests are planned and executed
- Coordinate and align Business, IT, OT and Service Continuity to ensure Business Continuity activities (like BIAs and tests) run smoothly and consistently
- Develop and maintain emergency and contingency plans (e.g., pandemics, natural disasters)
- Support the Crisis Management Support Team with Business Continuity Plans (BCPs)
- Design and implement BCM awareness initiatives and training programs
- Report on BCM maturity and roadmap progress to BU Board and VP BCM
- Manage and document incident reporting and emergency procedures, ensuring alignment across key stakeholders (e.g., ISO, DPO, IT Head, OT Head)
Your Profile – authentic undamp; open-minded
- Several years of professional experience in Business Continuity Management in matrix organizations and/or functional organizations
- Strong track record in implementing BCM programs at scale
- Operational experience across diverse business functions
- Strong understanding of IT/OT service continuity and disaster recovery concepts (e.g. RTO/RPO, resilience patterns)
- Expert knowledge of ISO 22301 and basic understanding of ISO27001, 27019 and 27031
- Relevant BCM/ Resilience certification such as CBCI, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or equivalent
- Good understanding of grid/energy systems, IT and OT environments
- High ownership and decision-making capability, even under uncertainty
- Excellent communication and influencing skills across stakeholders
- Strategic thinking who connects big-picture goals with practical execution
- Strong business acumen with understanding of value, risk, and operations
- Fluent in English and local language (written and spoken)
- Valid driver’s license (Class B)
Our Benefits – smart undamp; useful​
- Recharge your battery: You have 30 days of paid vacation per year plus Christmas and New Year's Eve off. Your battery still needs charging? You can exchange parts of your salary for more paid vacation or you can take a sabbatical.​
- Advance your development: We grow and we want you to grow with us. Learning on the job, exchanging with others, or taking part in an individual training – our learning culture enables you to bring your personal and professional development to the next level.​
- Enjoy hybrid work: We combine office collaboration with focused work from home. It’s also possible to go on workation for up to 20 days per year within Europe.​​
- Stay active undamp; healthy: Benefit from a company-sponsored health membership.​
- Elevate your mobility: From car and bike leasing offers to a subsidised Deutschland-Ticket – your way is our way.​
- Think ahead: With our company pension scheme and a great insurance package we take care of your future.​
- This is by far not all… We are looking forward to speaking with you about further benefits during the hiring process.

Do you have questions?
For further information please contact the Talent Acquisition Team, ­EDT_Talent_Acquisition@eon.com.
Please understand that for data protection reasons we can only accept applications submitted via our portal. Unfortunately, we cannot consider application documents that reach us by email or post.
What you need to know:
Job Req ID: 244530
Contract type: Permanent
Working time: Full time
Company: E.ON Digital Technology GmbH
Location: Essen
Function area: Cyber Security; IT/Digital

Inclusion

It is important to us that people with disabilities have access to a fair application process, providing them with an opportunity to shine. Therefore, our representative body for severely disabled people will be included in the process from an early stage. Please let us know via the application form if you require technical or organisational adjustments during the application process. We will strive to make the required aids available.

jobs.occupation: Change Manager (w/m/d) (Kommunikationspsychologe/-psychologin)
jobs.description:
Join our team in Bonn as Change Manager, starting as soon as possible (fixed-term position for 1 year)

The Finance Systems Transformation Team is responsible for running the SHAPE+ program - a DHL Group wide cross-divisional Finance transformation program. SHAPE+ aims at driving standardization and automation of core Accounting and Cost Accounting processes across Business Units and its consolidation into ONE SAP S/4HANA Finance ERP platform. This will significantly increase the efficiency and effectiveness of our Finance set-up and is the necessary basis for the continuous transformation and digitalization of the DHL Group’s Finance organization globally.

As Change Manager within the Change, Communication and Training (CCT) Academy, you as discipline owner for Change Management will be responsible for defining and executing change activities to enable change in close collaboration with the Senior Management to make the transformation as smooth as possible. In addition, you will be supporting the CCT Academy Team in realizing communications and training activities.

 

As an agile working team, the CCT Academy ensures that the rollout teams are always up to speed and end users are well prepared for the SHAPE+ rollout of the new processes and platform. We act as one CCT Academy team acknowledging the close connection of Change, Communication and Training activities. We all have our clear focus areas according to our expertise but realize our CCT vision jointly supporting each other in all CCT areas. 

 

Your tasks

 
* Ensure professional and efficient change management during the SHAPE+ deployment, for larger releases, enabling a successful system/release implementation and user adoption
* Own and maintain the approach for all activities related to Change Management and application enablement and governance
* Proactively identify change needs, define actions, execute, track and report on all change measures
* Accountable for the overall change execution and implementation assurance
* Develop change agility and resilience amongst the SHAPE+ community
* Steer divisional teams throughout the different program phases and ensure that the divisional teams realize the agreed change management activities also on an entity level
* Collaborate with our divisional rollout teams to ensure alignment of change, communications and training needs across all entities involved
* Support the divisions in successfully leading change, e.g. with Leading Change Workshop and train-the-trainer module
* Support the successful end-user adoption of new processes and tools e.g. by the use of Digital Adoption Tools, application of UX principles and End-User-Surveys

 

Your profile

 
* Passionate Change Manager with the ability to influence and motivate teams
* Experienced in enabling employees to adapt to change and implement it successfully
* Open minded with a can-do attitude and persistence, comfortable in a fast-moving, fluid, international environment
* Execution mindset and strong desire to consistently generate tangible outputs and value
* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, moderate difficult discussions, and deliver presentations effectively, addressing diverse seniority levels
* Min. 3 years of experience with Digital Adoption Tool knowledge, e.g. WalkMe, Oracle Guided Learning, SAP companion 
* Proficient English and German skills are a must have (verbal and written)
* Strong organizational skills and thorough experience in project management
* Min. 4 years work experience in the area of Change Management or similar disciplines
* Experience within the DHL Group, Finance or SAP FI/CO process knowledge is a plus

 

Your benefits

 
* Competitive compensation package with 20% variable part
* Company pension plans and other forms of retirement provision
* Salary conversion for environmentally friendly commuting, leasing of company bicycle or lease of electric company car. Alternatively conventional vehicles are available, too 
* Flexible working arrangements, such as part-time options or remote work possibilities
* Health and well-being initiatives, such as sabbaticals or measures to promote a healthy work-life balance incl. health management initiatives, including preventive check-ups, sports activities
* Work-family balance by offering company day care facilities in Bonn and cooperation with pme Familienservice, offering services such as childcare during school holidays
* Opportunities for further education and development, such as training / mentoring programs, workshops, or support for professional growth. Fast-paced development opportunities driven by best practices and cutting-edge solutions, keeping up with the latest trends and technologies
* Collaborate with executives and senior management in the global finance community, contributing to strategic decision-making processes and become a game changer in the largest Finance transformation in the industry
* Emphasis on respect and results and the opportunity to make a positive impact, such as through corporate social responsibility initiatives or involvement in charitable projects, Go Teach, Go Help, Global Volunteer Day, taking part in team-building activities or company event, such as summer party, Bonn Marathon etc.
* Subsidized Germany-wide public transportation ticket and various employee discounts and offers from external providers

 

Your contact

Please contact Hannah Braselmann, Head of Change Management, Communication and Training Academy, for further information: hannah.braselmann@dhl.com

We are looking forward to your application.

 

CONNECTING PEOPLE IMPROVING LIVES

You will operate across the full lifecycle—from product development interfaces to early opportunity shaping and bid readiness to project execution—ensuring risk management is consistently applied in line with our standards and with a nuclear standards and regulations. jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Cost Engineer (f/m/d), you will drive diverse projects and initiatives. The major objective of Cost and Value Engineering is the generation of high customer value at competitive target costs in product, project and solution business. Generating transparency in the respective cost and value drivers along the entire value chain by applying state of the art Cost and Value Engineering (CVE) methodology.

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Leadership of Cost and Value Engineering initiatives that improve competitiveness and profitability by embedding CVE practices into core business processes
* Establishment of cost and value transparency across products, solutions, and third-party scopes using should-costing methodologies and tools such as TcPCM, aPriori, MLPP, and CBD
* Support target setting and Design-to-Cost activities by aligning customer needs, competitor insights, technical capabilities, and development requirements
* Execution of should-cost analyses and assess supplier quotations to enable informed sourcing decisions and strengthen supplier cost transparency
* Identification and realization of cost-out opportunities across the portfolio through cross-functional workshops, innovation efforts, design-for-manufacturing activities, and efficiency projects

* University Degree in engineering; master’s degree is preferred
* Fluency in English with cross-cultural collaboration experience as well as good German skills
* Experience in should costing methods and realization of cost and value optimization opportunities
